stories.title: Release Team Claim Within Grace Period
stories.goal: release my team claim within 24 hours if I claimed the wrong team by mistake
stories.benefit: I can correct my mistake without needing to contact league admins or wait for approval
acceptanceCriteria: User can access 'Release Team Claim' option in profile or settings within 24 hours of claiming
System displays warning dialog explaining consequences of releasing claim
User confirms release action with secondary confirmation prompt
System immediately releases team claim and removes manager role assignment
Released team returns to available teams list for other users to claim
User is redirected to role selection to reclaim correct team or join as fan
System logs claim release with timestamp for audit purposes

stories.title: View Grace Period Status and Countdown
stories.goal: see how much time remains in my grace period for releasing team claim
stories.benefit: I know when my claim becomes permanent and can act quickly if I made a mistake
acceptanceCriteria: User profile displays grace period status for recent team claims
System shows countdown timer indicating time remaining in 24-hour grace period
Countdown displays in clear format (e.g., '18 hours 23 minutes remaining')
System displays 'Claim Locked' status after grace period expires
User receives notification 1 hour before grace period expires
System provides clear explanation of what happens when grace period expires

stories.title: Prevent Content Loss During Grace Period Release
stories.goal: ensure my posts and interactions are handled appropriately if I release team claim
stories.benefit: I don't lose my content or cause data inconsistencies when correcting a claim mistake
acceptanceCriteria: System warns user if they have created posts or comments before releasing claim
System preserves all user-generated content when claim is released
Released content remains attributed to user but team association is removed or updated
User can optionally choose to delete posts made with wrong team identity during release
System updates user attribution on existing content to reflect role change
System maintains content integrity and prevents broken references after release

stories.title: Notify Admins of Grace Period Releases
stories.goal: be informed when users release team claims within grace period
stories.benefit: I can monitor claim activity and identify potential onboarding issues or confusion
acceptanceCriteria: System sends notification to league admins when user releases claim in grace period
Notification includes user identity, team that was released, and time of release
Admin can view grace period release history in admin dashboard
Dashboard displays release reasons if user provided feedback during release
Admin can identify patterns indicating confusing team claim process
System provides analytics on grace period release rates for process improvement

stories.title: Reclaim Different Team After Grace Period Release
stories.goal: immediately claim the correct team after releasing wrong team in grace period
stories.benefit: I can fix my mistake quickly in single session without losing access or waiting
acceptanceCriteria: System immediately returns user to team selection interface after releasing claim
User can browse available teams and claim correct team without delay
System validates new claim using same platform username/ID verification process
New claim starts fresh 24-hour grace period independently
System prevents users from repeatedly claiming and releasing same team (maximum 2 releases per day)
User receives confirmation of successful reclaim with new grace period countdown

stories.title: Request Admin Override for Post-Grace Period Changes
stories.goal: request admin help to change team claim after grace period has expired
stories.benefit: I have recourse if I discover mistake after grace period without being permanently stuck
acceptanceCriteria: User can submit 'Request Team Change' form from profile after grace period expires
Form requires user to explain reason for requested change
System creates admin approval request with user details and explanation
Admin receives notification of team change request
Request enters admin queue for manual review and approval
User receives notification when admin approves or denies request
Approved requests allow admin to manually reassign user to different team

stories.title: Extend Grace Period for Complex Situations
stories.goal: manually extend grace period for users in special circumstances
stories.benefit: I can accommodate users who need more time due to platform issues or legitimate confusion
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can view all users currently in grace period from admin dashboard
Admin can select user and extend their grace period by specified time increment
System updates grace period countdown for selected user
User receives notification that their grace period has been extended
Admin can add note explaining reason for extension
System logs grace period extensions for audit purposes

stories.title: Configure Grace Period Duration
stories.goal: adjust the grace period duration for my league based on our needs
stories.benefit: I can set appropriate grace period that balances flexibility with stability
acceptanceCriteria: Admin can access grace period configuration in league settings
Admin can set grace period duration in hours (minimum 1 hour, maximum 72 hours)
System provides recommended grace period based on league size and complexity
Changes to grace period duration apply to future claims immediately
Existing grace periods continue with originally assigned duration
System displays warning if grace period is set too short or too long

stories.title: Display Grace Period Education During Claiming
stories.goal: understand grace period policy before claiming team
stories.benefit: I know I have safety net if I make mistake and can claim with confidence
acceptanceCriteria: Team selection interface displays clear explanation of grace period policy
System shows grace period duration and what actions are allowed during period
User sees examples of common mistakes grace period helps resolve
System provides link to detailed help article about claim process
Grace period information is displayed before user confirms team claim
System includes grace period details in claim confirmation message

stories.title: Prevent Team Hopping via Grace Period Abuse
stories.goal: prevent users from exploiting grace period to frequently change teams
stories.benefit: team claims remain stable and users can't manipulate system for unfair advantages
acceptanceCriteria: System limits users to maximum 2 claim releases per 7-day period
System flags users who repeatedly use grace period releases
Admin receives notification if user attempts excessive claim releases
System temporarily blocks claim ability for users who abuse grace period
User receives clear message explaining why claim ability is restricted
Admin can review flagged users and manually restore claim ability if appropriate
